cases.name: Anita Fagiani Andrews
cases.about:
She was named queen of the county fair and horse show in 1940 when she was 17. She worked as a secretary at Napa State Hospital. After her father died, she co-owned Fagiani’s. Family and friends remember her as a caring, hard-working and responsible mother of two. She also worked at the Napa State Hospital.
